title: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not apply the per-link visibility rules of space sidebar links…
description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin versions before 2.13.0 fail to enforce per-link visibility rules for space sidebar links in the space discovery feature. This flaw allows unauthenticated visitors to access titles and URLs of links that should be restricted to logged-in users or specific memberships, including disabled links, across all public and private spaces.
